feeds.title: Linda Blondheim Blog
feeds.description: Linda's mission as a landscape painter centers on capturing the essence of Florida's rural, agricultural lands, and trees through visual art. Believing that painters serve as custodians of history and culture, Linda aims to depict the experiences and lives of contemporary society. Her legacy is rooted in preserving and showcasing the inherent beauty of rural Florida through her artistic endeavors.
